protocol.selection: Every shadow ledger row, sorted by recorded timestamp and record key; no outcome-based selection or row cap.
funding_baselines: last settled rate strictly before entry, projected over the frozen hold with frozen signed weights
protocol.economic_baseline: no trade: zero trading P&L, excluding idle-capital returns
protocol.aggregation: Paired mean absolute errors on the same eligible records, plus equal-weight entry batches and pair/hold breakdowns.
protocol.incomplete: Keep every pending, missed or incomplete record with its reason. Never impute an outcome.
protocol.interpretation: Overlapping holds and shared instruments are dependent; no statistical significance or portfolio return is inferred.
protocol.history_boundary: Historical predictions were recorded before paper outcomes; this evaluation protocol is retrospective for existing records.
